user.title: Set up Frickeldave Store Sync
user.description: The base integration `frickeldave_store` must be set up first; it provides the store, the permissions and the extension point this integration registers with. Repository, branches, workflow and token can be changed in the options afterwards.

abort.base_missing: The base integration `frickeldave_store` is not set up.

init.title: Frickeldave Store Sync – settings
init.description: Publications always commit to the integration branch; `main` is only updated by the production workflow. The token is stored write-only and never shown again.

data.image_base_url: Image base URL for the import

data_description.repository: Repository that receives the catalogue and product images. Commits go to the integration branch.
data_description.dev_branch: Branch for publications. A commit here triggers fd-ci and fd-deploy-dev.
data_description.prod_branch: Branch the production workflow promotes to. Direct commits are not allowed.
data_description.prod_workflow: Workflow that promotes dev to main and deploys production.
data_description.token: Fine-grained token with Contents: write and Actions: write. Never returned, logged or exported. Leave empty to keep the stored token.
data_description.catalog_url: Only https hosts from the allowlist are permitted (frickeldave.de, raw.githubusercontent.com).
data_description.image_base_url: Base URL of the product images; same allowlist as the catalogue.

error.invalid_repository: The repository must use the form owner/name.
error.invalid_branch: The branch must not be empty and must not contain spaces.
error.invalid_workflow: The workflow must be a file name such as fd-deploy-prd.yml.
error.invalid_source_url: The catalogue URL must be an https URL on the allowlist (frickeldave.de, raw.githubusercontent.com).
error.invalid_image_url: The image URL must be an https URL on the allowlist (frickeldave.de, raw.githubusercontent.com).
